High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Tallon Roll (PC Errata 2018 E card)|Tallon Roll (PC Errata)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Tallon Roll _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1U0NLme_AADaWgDv5GU6aDw3FFK2SdJ8Y/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Tallon Roll _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,688 bytes, SHA-256 <code>3c2ade3bc78c8c9b4bd5b72a919196126c6a59f571b49e85ca0a42c2765a3a61</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Premiere-D-tallonroll.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.
